title: Relationship Relief on Rural Home Loans Late Charges for Farm Real Estate Borrowers
content:
**Resolution on relationship relief.** Relationship relief on a late charge on a Rural Home Loans loan depends on the member's farm real estate lending with the association, as the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records show it.

## Tiers of relief

1. A member whose farm real estate loan is active and shows at least two farm principal installments paid and no farm loan late charge in the last 24 months, an installment whose remittance was returned not counting as paid, has 80 percent of the charge taken off.
2. A member whose farm real estate loan is active and shows a farm loan late charge in the last 24 months has 35 percent taken off.
3. Any other member, including one with no active farm real estate loan and one whose active farm loan shows fewer than two farm principal installments paid and no farm loan late charge in those 24 months, has no relief.

## Records read on the Farm Real Estate Loans side

- **Status** of the member's farm real estate loan: active or not.
- **Farm principal installments paid:** the principal payments booked on the farm loan in the last 24 months, less the principal payment returns booked in those months.
- **Farm loan late charges:** late-charge fees assessed on the farm loan in the last 24 months.

The last 24 months run from the day after the same calendar day 24 months before today through today.

## How the relief acts

The relief percentage is taken off the gross late charge — the charge as measured on the home loan — once, before the charge is raised to its floor or lowered to the product's maximum late charge; nothing is rounded until the end.

## Truth table

| Farm loan active | Farm installments paid (net of returns) | Farm late charge in 24 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | none | 80 percent |
| yes | any number | one or more | 35 percent |
| yes | 0 or 1 | none | none |
| no farm loan, or not active | — | — | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- Three farm installments paid and one of them returned leaves 2 paid; with no farm late charge on an active farm loan, the relief is 80 percent: a gross charge of 60.00 becomes 12.00 before the floor and the maximum are applied.
- Two farm installments paid, one returned, leaves 1 paid; with no farm late charge, there is no relief.
